===== RUN 142: MW6 skb+0x78 direction-bit writers =====
Proven semantics from nos.ko tbq_timer_func:
  bit 0x2 = WAN TX / client upload / LAN->WAN
  bit 0x1 = WAN RX / client download / WAN->LAN
